text: Aesthesodic [Gr. aisqhsiV , sensation, + odoV , road]: Ger. reizleitend , aesthesodisch (applied to spinal ganglia, not to cortical centres -- H.M. ); Fr. (not used); Ital. estesiodico . Receptive rather than centrifugal or initiatory. An aesthesodic centre is one which receives stimuli from a centripetal nerve, especially a cortical centre forming the central end-organ for a sensory-tract. See KINESODIC. A more inclusive term than 'sensory' in the same connections, and not implying that the stimuli necessarily participate in sensation. ( H.H. )
